title: Positions
description: All stances of one actor. Path: data/positions/people/<slug>.json or data/positions/organizations/<slug>.json. Entries are kept sorted by (subject, as_of); several dated entries on one subject record how a position changed.

subject.description: An issue question (q:...) or a ballot measure (contest:...).

stance.description: support/oppose/mixed: from explicit cited evidence. declined_to_answer: the actor was asked and did not answer (a fact about the actor, so cited). no_public_position: we searched and found nothing (a fact about our research, so it carries a search_log instead of citations). Never inferred from party.

summary.description: One or two plain, neutral sentences paraphrasing the evidence. No adjectives that characterize the actor.

points.description: Specific elements of the stance, each cited. `facet` names one of the question's facets, so the same element lines up across candidates (shared vs. only one).

text.description: Short neutral paraphrase of what the actor said on this element.

as_of.description: Date the stance is current as of. Every cited source must be published on or before this date.
